blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY, Philippines — For seven days, the barbed wires and concrete perimeters of Iligan City Jail in Lanao del Norte will witness a quiet conversation about reformation and second chances. Jail authorities on Sunday morning rolled out a convoy through the industrial city’s main roads, launching the local run of the National Correctional Consciousness Week (NACOCOW) 2026. The message they brought along was simple: a detention cell should serve as a workshop for a broken life, not its terminal stop.
